extension.summary: Functional: a clean, opinionated Kodi skin
extension.description: Functional. Built for clarity: gallery library views, configurable accent colour, slide-out filters, side-by-side library stats on home, and a tight video OSD.
extension.news: Coming up list, a Home Screen setting offered when the Engage add-on is installed, beside the Coming up block and independent of it. The next Engage slots run down the left of Home, each with its episode or film and when it is due; OK on a row opens Engage. The list starts under the logo and a top menu and grows down as far as the layout allows, up to eleven rows with the logo hidden and the menu out of its way; a wide menu row across the centre ends it above the row. It shows once an Engage release publishes the slots; until then nothing appears. A centred menu row of up to four tiles now sits on the screen centre beside the stats column instead of being pushed left with the wider rows.
